# Invoice

> A local-first invoicing PWA built on @niclaslindstedt/oss-framework.
> Register the company that sends the invoices and the customers that
> receive them, write invoices against a template, rearrange the sections
> of the page in an edit mode, and print or save the result as a PDF from
> the device. One document, stored on-device in IndexedDB, with an optional
> copy in a local folder or the user's own Dropbox. A companion to the Time
> app: a range of hours exported there drops onto an invoice here as lines.

- App: https://invoice.niclaslindstedt.se/
- Source: https://github.com/niclaslindstedt/invoice
- Framework: https://github.com/niclaslindstedt/oss-framework
- Companion: https://github.com/niclaslindstedt/time

## Features

- Invoices: draft, send, mark paid, credit; a number series, due dates and
  late-payment terms per region; lines with quantity, unit, price and VAT
  rate; totals per VAT rate; a history of what happened to each invoice
- Preview and edit mode: the invoice as it prints, and the same page with
  every section movable (drag, or up/down), hideable, and editable in place
- Sources: a customer's or the company's details edited from the invoice
  update the record itself, and every change is kept as a revision you can
  read back
- Customers: name, address, references, region-specific identifiers such as
  a Swedish organisation number, and the edit history of each
- Company: who sends the invoice — identifiers, bank details, the notice a
  region requires (Sweden's "Godkänd för F-skatt")
- Templates: a typeface out of a bundled set, an accent, a paper, which
  sections a new invoice starts with and in what order
- Regions: one folder per region holding its rules, identifiers, VAT rates
  and required sections; Sweden today, built so a second region is a folder
- Drop a file exported from Time onto an invoice and its hours become lines
- English and Swedish; light and dark theme
- No account, no server, no analytics; installable and fully offline
